title: 美联储八次变六次：市场要重新适应，信号还是转向
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Bloomberg learning that chair wars is considering changes to the frequency and timing of the central bank's policy meetings.
segments.zh: 彭博获悉，主席沃什正考虑调整央行政策会议的频率和时间。

segments.en: Let's get more with Bloomberg's Alistair bull. Alistair, what would it mean to this market if the Fed chair, I guess, in concert with the FOMC, decided that six meetings were enough per year to talk about monetary policy?
segments.zh: 让我们连线彭博的阿里斯泰尔·布尔。阿里斯泰尔，如果美联储主席与联邦公开市场委员会一致决定每年六次会议讨论货币政策，这对市场意味着什么？

segments.en: As an intriguing thought, so it would push the number of policy meetings from six to eight weeks between them. That would be consistent with what we've heard chair wars talk about to reduce the market sort of finger trigger reliance and utterances from the referee and to play the ball and not the ref.
segments.zh: 这是个有趣的想法，这样会议间隔将从六周延长到八周。这与沃什主席提到的减少市场对官员言论的过度反应、关注实质而非表态的意图相符。

segments.en: So I think that they would adjust reasonably quickly. The other intriguing component of the reporting was that they would look to try and align the meetings more with the schedule of data releases.
segments.zh: 我认为他们会较快适应。报道中另一个有趣的方面是，他们试图让会议时间与数据发布日程更匹配。

segments.en: And that just makes common sense. I mean, if you can hold a meeting with as much information as possible in front of you, that would be a good thing, rather than the situation at the moment when they meet on a Tuesday and Wednesday.
segments.zh: 这很合理。如果能在掌握尽可能多信息的情况下开会，那当然是好事，而不是像现在这样在周二和周三开会。

segments.en: And then you have a big data release on the Thursday or payrolls on the Friday, and they've kind of been flying blind.
segments.zh: 然后周四有重要数据发布，周五有非农就业数据，他们几乎是在盲目飞行。

segments.en: So I mean, I think the market will be intrigued on the paper. It doesn't seem such a radical shift. And we wait to hear more.
segments.zh: 所以我认为市场会对此感兴趣。这似乎不是激进的转变，我们等待更多细节。

segments.en: But one thing that wasn't discussed in the reporting was whether each of these meetings would still be accompanied by a press conference. And so that's certainly a question we'd like to circle back to.
segments.zh: 但报道中未提及的是，是否每次会议后仍会举行新闻发布会。这无疑是我们想回头确认的问题。
